purpose: The Model Vault reads this catalogue before it offers a local-model package for selection.

models.reason: The verified 60.1 GB warehouse and exact runtime profile are present. A clean-card run and completed-answer suite must still establish the public claim range.
The original 32-layer expert packs and recipes remain, but the complete checkpoint, tokenizer, shared backbone and customer-card acceptance result are not currently available as one package.

The 50+ tokens/s resident Q2 candidate has a preserved technical record, but its model file was not retained in the mounted archive. Its small quality cohort also requires broader acceptance testing before release.

Official Qwen3.8-27B is the next Local Pro candidate. Tessaris will evaluate an 18 GB-safe GGUF representation, vision support, normal business quality, and normal-use throughput before packaging or publishing a claim.

MiniMax H3 is an open-weights video candidate for compatible GPU workstations. Its custom community licence, commercial distribution terms, complete payload size, and device requirements must be approved before Tessaris offers any local package. It is not an 18 GB Mac SD-card release candidate.

The 8 GB entry tier is reserved for a tested 3B-class local worker. Granite 3B is the current recovery candidate; Tessaris must retain or rebuild a complete checkpoint, tokenizer, runtime profile and 8 GB acceptance receipt before release.

Gemma is a candidate for the 8 GB and 16 GB Fast Local tiers. Tessaris must select the exact upstream release and representation, then establish device-safe memory floors, normal-use throughput and business-task acceptance.
Ministral 3 8B is a candidate for the 16 GB Fast Local tier. It requires a signed runtime profile and 16 GB device acceptance before it is selectable.
GPT-OSS-20B is reserved as a stronger private-reasoning candidate for 16 GB-plus compatible devices and Hub profiles. A device-specific package and acceptance suite are required before release.

DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B is reserved as a private-reasoning candidate for 16 GB-plus compatible devices and Hub profiles. It requires a selected representation, licensing review and acceptance receipts.
Muse Glimmer is reserved as a local agent and coding candidate. Tessaris must validate the exact release, device profile, tool-use harness and agent-safety acceptance before release.
